verdict.rationale: Power efficiency is a fair axis for a datacenter GPU, but the evidence pack contains no documented MI325X power envelope (TDP/TBP) and no independent performance-per-watt testing. The listed specs cover only VRAM, compute units and architecture. AMD SMI and the metrics exporter are generic monitoring tools, an adjacent capability that does not evidence efficiency.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, sustained workloads are power-efficient on this part — documented power envelopes with independent performance-per-watt testing
